title: CHAPTER EIGHT. Some who acknowledge Scripture wrongly deny the resurrection of the flesh; better assert it
pass_a_gloss: By the ancients, as by the Sadducees, Hymenaeus, Philetus, and the like. III. It stands as denied either by the ancients or by certain more recent ones. II. The resurrection belonging toward the flesh stands as wrongly denied by some who acknowledge the authority of Sacred Scripture, but stands as firmly asserted by others and better ones. It stands as demonstrated that the resurrection belonging toward the flesh stands as denied by some to whom the authority of Scripture stands as established. CHAPTER EIGHT.
pass_b_english: CHAPTER EIGHT. It is demonstrated that the resurrection of the flesh is denied by some to whom the authority of Scripture is established.
The resurrection of the flesh is wrongly denied by some who acknowledge the authority of Sacred Scripture, but is firmly asserted by others and better ones.
II. It is denied either by the ancients or by certain more recent ones.
III. By the ancients, as by the Sadducees, Hymenaeus, Philetus, and the like.
source_text: CAPUT OCTAVUM, Demonstratur, resurrectionem carnis a nonnullis, quibus de scripturae authoritate constat, negari. Resurrectio carnis a nonnullis qui sacrae scripturae authoritatem agnoscunt, perperam negatur, ab aliis vero & melioribus firmiter asseritur. II. Negatur vel ab antiquis, vel a quibusdam recentioribus. III. Ab antiquis, ut Sadduceis, Hymenaeo, Phileto & similibus.
